_doc: OWE BLOCK BRAWL asset manifest. JSON has no comments, so this array documents the format.
sheets: { id: { src, frame:[w,h], spacing, margin, columns, rows } }
src is relative to this file. Frame index = row*columns + col, counted from 0 at the top-left.
Source x = margin + col*(w+spacing); y = margin + row*(h+spacing).
View any sheet with indices: tools/atlas.html?sheet=<id>&scale=4 (optional &cols=a-b, &from=, &to=).
tilesets: { mines|rooftops|pipepit: { sheet, roles:{...}, placeholder:{ role:'#hex' }, edge:{light,dark} } }
Roles used by the map renderer:
floor      walkable ground. Repeated indices weight the pick.
wall       wall FACE: a wall tile whose south neighbor is not wall (the brick front you see).
wallTop    wall TOP: a wall tile with wall to its south (the raised rock surface).
wallTopAlt rare wall-top variant (about 1 in 61 top tiles).
pit        void pit (Stage 5 hazard).
cover      destructible cover props (Stage 4+).
deco       floor overlays scattered by the generator (full tiles; they replace the floor tile).
hazard_*   hazard visuals (Stage 5).
When a role lists several indices, a position hash picks one per tile.
edge: colors of the procedural rim drawn where a wall top meets floor or a wall face.
characters: paper-doll layers from the 'chars' sheet, drawn bottom to top:
body, legs (pants), shoes, torso, hair, beard, hat.
body/hair/beard are flat lists. legs/shoes/torso/hat are keyed by palette: red | blue | grey | police.
A -1 entry means 'nothing' (e.g. no hat). beardChance = chance a fighter gets a beard.
recolor.<palette>: hue remap applied only to legs/shoes/torso/hat, because the sheet has no true red or blue.
Pixels with hue in hueFrom and saturation >= minSat move to hueTo; sat and light scale them.
red: the sheet's orange outfits -> crimson (Crimson Cutters). blue: teal outfits -> blue (Seaside Circus).
police: plumes and any colored bits -> dark navy (Gobbler's police). grey: no remap (the Newcomer).
placeholder: flat colors for the fallback figure.
icons: { itemId: { sheet, frame } }. Prefer Tiny Dungeon weapons, potions, staffs. Missing icon -> placeholder.
anims: { name: { sheet, row, frames, fps } } for future animated sheets. Empty for now.
Fallback: if an image fails to load or a key is missing, a flat rectangle in the role's placeholder color is drawn.
?placeholders=1 forces placeholders everywhere; the game must stay fully playable that way.
